mapper.select: SELECT i.*, p.product_name, p.product_code FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id ORDER BY i.id
SELECT i.*, p.product_name, p.product_code FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (product_id, warehouse, quantity, min_quantity, max_quantity, last_updated) VALUES (#{productId}, #{warehouse}, #{quantity}, #{minQuantity}, #{maxQuantity}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET product_id = #{productId}, warehouse = #{warehouse}, quantity = #{quantity}, min_quantity = #{minQuantity}, max_quantity = #{maxQuantity}, last_updated = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
